label: Elevated Distress Profile
summary: A female respondent with graduate-level education and more than five hours of daily media or screen use, reporting higher-than-average loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours of daily media or screen use.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 scale (mean 1.69).
Reports higher depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9 (mean 1.75).
Reports higher anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7 (mean 2.16).
Spends more than 5 hours per day on media or screen use.
tone: Reserved and reflective, with a tendency toward worry and low mood.

label: Low-Distress Male Graduate Profile
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education who reports low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms, with 1–3 hours of a specified activity in the profile.

label: Low Distress, Moderate Digital Use
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education who reports low loneliness and low symptoms of depression and anxiety, alongside 1–3 hours of daily digital use.
demographic_anchor: Male; graduate degree or above; 1–3 hours of daily digital use.
behavior_markers: Spends 1–3 hours per day on digital activities
tone: Calm, stable, and low-distress; likely to engage in a measured and composed manner.
